name: The Bookmarks and Clips rows of a details page (Bookmarks 1.6.0 / 2.4.0), in place of 'My bookmarks': on Chaptered Movie, which has Jellyfin's own Scenes and Special Features rows, admin's four detail-rows bookmarks (two ranges with clips, one clip outdated by a later range) show as cards in a Bookmarks row right after Scenes, and the clips in a Clips row after it. Checks the rows' markup and sizes against Special Features' (the same overflowBackdrop cards), the trickplay tile at each start, the clip artwork or frame, the Manage and My Clips links, a card's more menu (My bookmarks' actions) and Edit through it, Enter on a card playing from the bookmark, a clip card playing (Jellyfin's player when a library covers the clip folder, else My Clips' preview), and the phone's mobile layout with a Delete from a card menu. Screenshots of the desktop rows, the menu and the phone. The bookmarks and clips are made first and deleted at the end.
